name: matrix-seo-ai-search-manager
description: Audit Matrix Wix pages, inspect available free search and analytics reports, propose precise SEO and AI search improvements for owner approval, and apply and verify approved changes.

interface.longDescription: Audit existing Matrix pages or prepare SEO requirements for new pages. Use available Wix, Google Search Console, Google Analytics and free technical checks; present page performance, evidence and exact before-and-after changes for owner approval. Execute only approved edits, preserve existing design and URLs, and verify saved and published results separately. Uses connected Wix, Google Drive, GitHub and browser capabilities; Google reporting requires existing authorized account access or exports. No paid SEO reporting subscription is required. Runs when invoked, not as an unattended background service.
defaultPrompt: Audit Matrix's service and location pages, check available free performance reports, and show me prioritized changes for approval.
Prepare the SEO and AI search requirements for this new Matrix page and show me the exact copy, links and schema for approval.
Apply the changes I approved in the latest Matrix SEO report and verify the results.
